verdict.rationale: The only sprint-related evidence is a passing mention that Linear has 'cycles', a workspace object that Loops can react to. Separately, the docs make generic claims about planning from idea to launch and running weekly planning. Nothing documents how to create, schedule, or manage sprints. Missing for 10: documentation of cycle/sprint creation and scheduling, backlog-to-sprint planning, sprint progress tracking (e.g. burndown, rollover), and independent or hands-on corroboration of sprint management.
